description: Get a specific comment from a Zendesk request. Use when you need to retrieve a single comment by its ID for a given request, such as displaying a specific comment detail or checking comment metadata. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for getting a specific comment from a Zendesk request.

request_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk request. You can find this ID in the request URL or from a list requests action.
request_id.title: Request Id

ticket_comment_id.description: The ID of the ticket comment
ticket_comment_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the specific comment within the request. This can be found by listing comments on the request first.
ticket_comment_id.title: Ticket Comment Id

inputSchema.title: GetRequestsCommentRequest

name: get_requests_comment

content_url.description: URL to access the attachment file
content_url.title: Content Url

thumbnails.description: Array of thumbnail attachments for images
thumbnails.title: Thumbnails

CommentDetail.description: Detailed comment object returned from the API.

audit_id.description: The id of the ticket audit record
audit_id.title: Audit Id

author_id.description: The id of the comment author
author_id.title: Author Id

created_at.description: The time the comment was created
created_at.title: Created At

id.description: Automatically assigned when the comment is created
id.title: Id

metadata.description: System information (web client, IP address, etc.) and comment flags
metadata.title: Metadata

plain_body.description: The comment presented as plain text
plain_body.title: Plain Body

public.description: true if a public comment; false if an internal note
public.title: Public

type.description: `Comment` or `VoiceComment`. The JSON object for adding voice comments to tickets is different.
type.title: Type

uploads.description: List of tokens received from uploading files for comment attachments
uploads.title: Uploads

CommentDetail.title: CommentDetail

system.description: System-generated information (client, IP address, location, etc.)
system.title: System

via.description: Describes how the object was created
via.title: Via

GetRequestsCommentResponse.description: Response containing a single comment from a Zendesk request.
GetRequestsCommentResponse.title: GetRequestsCommentResponse

Via.description: Via object describing how the comment was created.

channel.description: How the comment was created (via type)
channel.title: Channel

Via.title: Via

from.description: Source sender information (address, name, phone, etc.)
from.title: From
